description: This file contains implementation code for managing the HIP9011 hardware component, including configuration, RPM lookup, and command handling logic within an embedded system firmware.

classes.name: HIP9011
classes.description: Class representing the HIP9011 hardware interface, responsible for configuration, command processing, and lookup table management.

methods.name: setStateAndCommand
methods.description: Sets the current state to sending SPI command and issues the command to hardware.

methods.name: prepareHip9011RpmLookup
methods.description: Precomputes RPM lookup values based on angle window width for faster real-time processing.

methods.name: getIntegrationIndexByRpm
methods.description: Finds the index in the RPM lookup table corresponding to a given RPM value.

methods.name: setAngleWindowWidth
methods.description: Calculates and sets the angle window width, updating lookup tables accordingly.

methods.name: handleValue
methods.description: Main handler that adjusts hardware parameters based on RPM and configuration.
